OtherTaxCodeIndicator.name: Other Tax Code Indicator
OtherTaxCodeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether or not another tax code exists.

CumulativeTaxIndicator.name: Cumulative Tax Indicator
CumulativeTaxIndicator.definition: Indicates whether tax is cumulative or non-cumulative. In the UK, this is known as the W1M1 indicator.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Start date of the employment period.

EndDate.name: End Date
EndDate.definition: End date of the employment period.
